استتفهت (form X)
# اِسْتَتْفَهْتُ (istatfahtu) /is.tat.fah.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اِسْتَتْفَهْتَ (istatfahta) /is.tat.fah.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اِسْتَتْفَهْتِ (istatfahti) /is.tat.fah.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اِسْتَتْفَهَتْ (istatfahat) /is.t
